summary.text: Tim Barhorst is a Republican state representative from Fort Loramie who has represented Ohio House District 85 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial advisor, he founded the employee benefits and financial planning firm Business Partners, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Barhorst was born in Ohio, graduated from Fort Loramie High School, earned an associate degree from Edison State Community College in 1991 and a bachelor's degree from Wright State University in 1993.

He founded Business Partners, Inc., and owned and operated Behm's Restaurant, and he served as legislation chairman for the Ohio Association of Health Underwriters and media relations chairman for the National Association of Health Underwriters Midwest Region.
Barhorst succeeded Nino Vitale in District 85 and defeated Democrat Victoria Maddox in the November 5, 2024 general election.
He serves on the Agriculture, Medicaid (vice chair), Health and Insurance committees.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a fiscal and social conservative with health care transparency expertise and listed health care transparency, energy affordability and sustainability, and fiscal responsibility as his key messages.
Victoria Maddox is again the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
